question: State whether the following statements are true or false: (a) Suspension pending departmental enquiry against a Government Servant is not a punishment. (d) On the outcome of disciplinary proceedings any of the prescribed punishments is imposed on a GS, a record of the same should invariably be kept in his confidential roll. (e) The Disciplinary Authority can impose any of the major penalties specified in Rule 11 of CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 without holding inquiry. (f) At least 'WARNING' should be awarded when decided to penalize a GS as a result of Departmental proceedings. (g) A government servant appointed directly to Sub-Inspector cannot be reduced to Assistant Sub-Inspector, i.e. a post which he never held before, by way of punishment. (h) Government servant against whom disciplinary proceeding was drawn may take the assistance of any other Government servant posted in any office to present the case on his behalf. (i) A common/ joint proceeding can be held against Government servants working in the same office who have made complaint against each other. (j) Receiving bribe is a type of case which may merit action for imposing one of the major penalties.
